read.thesis: Record $21.3B revenue and 26.6% ROTCE on Equities (+69%) and IB (+58%) strength; capital return up to $20B buyback, but no supply-side capacity signal, a bank not an industry-capacity story.

triggers.label: Equity revenue up 69% to record
triggers.quote: Equity net revenues were a record on strong performance across businesses and regions

triggers.label: Reauthorised $20B buyback from Q3
triggers.quote: reauthorized a multi-year common equity share repurchase program of up to $20 billion

red_flags.label: Loans up and SLR down to 4.9%
